headline: Approved $202,755.19 for furniture at 100 Freight St. and $66,019.50 for Moshassuck St. sewer remediation.
summary: Approved two Ford F250 trucks for $109,504.00 and a one-year extension of the Flock Cameras contract, with an annual fee of $60,000.00. Also approved two drone purchases, two contract amendments, and two on-call truck repair agreements. Project #26-011 for Tidewater Stairway Construction was canceled.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the September 24, 2026 meeting, unanimously.
Approved $66,019.50 proposal from International Paving for Moshassuck St. sewer remediation, unanimously.
Approved agreement with WB Mason of Brockton, MA, up to $202,755.19 for furniture, fixtures and equipment at 100 Freight St., unanimously.
Approved amendment to Contract #24-031 with Beta Group of Lincoln for $24,500.00 in bid phase services, unanimously.
Approved amendment to Contract #25-016 with SLR of Cheshire, CT for $24,000.00 in permitting support for Riverwalk West, unanimously.
Approved agreement with Onsite Truck Repair for on-call emergency repair services during the snow and ice season, unanimously.
Approved agreement with Fleet Master of Providence for on-call emergency repair services during the snow and ice season, unanimously.
Approved notice that Project #26-011 for Tidewater Stairway Construction was canceled, unanimously.
Approved cooperative purchase from Colonial Municipal Group of two Ford F250 trucks for the Fire Department at $109,504.00, unanimously.
Approved one-year extension of the Flock Cameras contract with the annual fee of $60,000.00 unchanged, unanimously.
Approved award of informal bid for a DJI Matrice 4TD drone to US Drone Supply of San Diego, CA, for $12,069.97, unanimously.
Approved award of informal bid for an all-weather DJI Matrice drone to Drone Nerds of Ft Lauderdale, FL, for $18,418.99, unanimously.

# CITY OF PAWTUCKET

## CITY HALL
137 ROOSEVELT AVENUE
PAWTUCKET, RHODE ISLAND 02860

## OFFICE OF THE PURCHASING DIVISION

Approved by: [signature]
Date: [unreadable]

## Purchasing Board Meeting Minutes
October 8, 2026

Present: Lisa Bessette, Christopher Brouillette, Mark Wildenhain, Peter Wingate, Purchasing Director, Jeannine Bourski, Acting Finance Director

Absent: Nancy Pelletier

Public Input Period: (none)

Bid Openings: (none)

Minutes: September 24, 2026 meeting minutes have been accepted. Lisa Bessette makes a motion to approve. Mark Wildenhain seconds. Unanimously approved

## Communications:

Joe Morais, DPW, is notifying the Board that, due to the mandate to add ADA accessibility and the discovery of unanticipated sewer structures in the area of the City's right-of-way on Moshassuck St, the City reached out to its contractor International Paving of West Warwick to provide a proposal on the City's behalf to remediate the situation. Agreed-to proposal in the amount of $66,019.50 to be paid out of the Highway Bond. Lisa Bessette makes a motion to approve. Christopher Brouillette seconds. Unanimously approved

Joe Morais, DPW, is notifying the Board that the City has reached an agreement with WB Mason of Brockton, MA, piggybacking the NASPO MPA #MA3963 contract for a second round of purchases of furniture, fixtures and equipment for 100 Freight St. Agreement in the amount up to $202,755.19 to be paid out of the Building Bond. Mark Wildenhain makes a motion to approve. Jeannine Bourski seconds. Unanimously approved

Mike Wilcox, DPW, is notifying the Board that an amendment to Contract #24-031 is in order with Beta Group of Lincoln to provided Bid Phase Services for projects 26-011 and 27-003 Agreed-to proposal in the amount of $24,500.00 to be paid out of RIIB, SNEP and Series 2024A Project Fund. Mark Wildenhain makes a motion to approve. Lisa Bessette seconds. Unanimously approved

Mike Wilcox, DPW, is notifying the Board that an amendment to Contract #25-016 is in order with SLR of Cheshire, CT to provided Federal Regulatory Permitting Support Services for Riverwalk West Projects 26-011 and 27-003. Agreed-to proposal in the amount of $24,000.00 to be paid out of RIIB, SNEP and Series 2024A Project Fund. Christopher Brouillette makes a motion to approve. Mark Wildenhain seconds. Unanimously approved

Rick Karsulavitch, DPW, is requesting that the Board approve an agreement with vendor Onsite Truck Repair to provide on call emergency repair services during the snow and ice season. Rates are $126/HR standard, $189/HR after hours and $252/HR on weekends. Lisa Bessette makes a motion to approve. Mark Wildenhain seconds. Unanimously approved.

Rick Karsulavitch, DPW, is requesting that the Board approve an agreement with RFP 24-002 contract vendor Fleet Master of Providence to provide on call emergency repair services during the snow and ice season. Rates are $150/HR standard, $200/HR after hours and $200/HR on weekends. Jeannine Bourski makes a motion to approve. Lisa Bessette seconds. Unanimously approved.

Mike Wilcox, DPW, is notifying the Board that Project #26-011 for Tidewater Stairway Construction has been canceled. Bidders will be notified and any rebid will be brought back to the Board for approval. Mark Wildenhain makes a motion to approve. Lisa Bessette seconds. Unanimously approved

Peter Wingate, Purchasing Director, on behalf of the Fire Department, is requesting that the Board approve a municipal cooperative procurement from Colonial Municipal Group of Marlborough, MA, piggybacking the pricing provided for their MAPC contract. Purchase is for two (2) Ford F250 trucks at a total cost of $109,504.00 to be paid out of the Fire Prevention Account #550745720. Mark Wildenhain makes a motion to approve. Lisa Bessette seconds. Unanimously approved

Major Dave Holden, Police, is requesting approval of a one-year extension of the department's contract with Flock Cameras of Atlanta, GA. No change to the annual fee of $60,000.00 as budgeted through the Computer/Maintenance Support General Fund 100 line item. Jeannine Bourski makes a motion to approve. Lisa Bessette seconds. Unanimously approved.

Major Dave Holden, Police, is notifying the Board of the award for its informal bid for a DJI Matrice 4TD drone to US Drone Supply of San Diego, CA, the highest-ranked responsive bidder. Cost of $12,069.97 paid in full with State Seizure Funds. Mark Wildenhain makes a motion to approve. Jeannine Bourski seconds. Unanimously approved.

Major Dave Holden, Police, is notifying the Board of the award for its informal bid for a DJI Matrice all-weather drone to Drone Nerds of Ft Lauderdale, FL, the highest-ranked responsive bidder. Cost of $18,418.99 paid in full with a grant from Bristol County Savings Bank. Lisa Bessette makes a motion to approve. Christopher Brouillette seconds. Unanimously approved.

Mark Wildenhain makes a motion to adjourn. Nancy Pelletier seconds. Unanimously approved.

Peter Wingate
[signature]
Purchasing Director
